name: onlyoffice
description: Agent skills for building integrations with ONLYOFFICE developer SDKs and tools. Today: embed-sdk — embedding DocSpace into web apps via the Embed SDK (@onlyoffice/docspace-sdk-js): modes, config, authentication, events, editor automation, troubleshooting; plugin-sdk — building, auditing and explaining DocSpace plugins via the Plugins SDK (@onlyoffice/docspace-plugin-sdk): React components built from @docspace/ui-kit, the plugin runtime hooks, scopes, items and actions, plus offline scaffolding and validation scripts.
